text_block_list.text:
Walking through town on my day off, I saw 
Yamanin Zephyr stepping out of a 
restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I had a delicious set meal. It came 
with so many side dishes, I'm very 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next up is the European salad 
bar—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Lured by the morning breeze, I have been 
traveling far and wide since dawn.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"And then, the gentle midday breeze made 
me realize that I hadn't eaten anything 
all day."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Once I realized that, I became terribly 
hungry, so I thought I would have another 
meal...
choice_data_list: Be careful not to overeat, okay?
Be careful not to overeat, okay?
I can't run on an empty stomach.
I can't run on an empty stomach, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Once I realized that, I became terribly 
hungry, so I thought I would have another 
meal...
choice_data_list: Be careful not to overeat, okay?
Be careful not to overeat, okay?
I can't run on an empty stomach.
I can't run on an empty stomach, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that is true. I was simply 
preoccupied with filling my stomach.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A wind that blows too fiercely sweeps many 
things away. Be moderate, lest you become 
that way yourself.

Afterward, Yamanin Zephyr enjoyed a 
moderate portion from the salad bar.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that shop offers such a wide variety 
of vegetables, so I'm sure it will be 
delightful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to go properly fill 
my stomach.

Afterward, Yamanin Zephyr headed to the 
salad bar and enjoyed every single 
vegetable on offer from one end to the 
other.
